comment: The case matrix of the soft-takeoff recette. runner: script = deterministic command that decides; agent = a cheap-model walkthrough that must return evidence; owner = a person (real money, real machines, a decision). status: ready | to-verify (a fact to confirm before the first run) | needs-build (something must exist first) | blocked (waits for an owner decision or a paid resource). Evidence never goes in git. light: true = part of the first, cheap wave. watch: the in-flight work whose delivery should make this case run again (cloud-budget = the session on Cloud budget and billing, slides = the session on slide creation and editing). expect: a canary, the verdict it must get. timeout: seconds, for a long case.

PASS. Account A on a desktop DSH (sandbox C paired to the play server, role admin) and account B on a cloud computer (owner) are in the SAME team space. A's skill reaches B: it is in the approved list on the computer, installs as a real folder on its volume, and is in the skills list of the computer's next agent request. B's lesson reaches A: it is in A's approved list, and the computer's own agent request carries it under « KYBERNOS TEAM LESSONS ». A's DSH on the personal space sees neither. The weak local model did not answer the code word (model, not product).

cases.title: A sleeping Free computer with no credit left is deleted after free_idle_delete_days
cases.note: Played by hand on real Fly machines, 2026-11-03 (evidence and replay kit: ~/kybernos-archive/soft-takeoff-2026-11-03/w3-fly/, kit/README.md; ledger section « Wave W3, real machines »). PASS. With `free_idle_delete_days` 7: a sleeping computer of a FREE workspace that still has credit is kept; once the credit is used up the hourly pass deletes it and its Fly app is gone; the idle computer of a PAID workspace of the same age is kept. The pass also wants the computer to be older than the delay (created_at), as a really idle one is; and a free workspace with no credit cannot make a computer at all (409 budget_exhausted).

cases.title: A failing bundle never stops DSH from starting (safe mode, bundle faults)
cases.note: Played 2026-11-03: `test-safe-mode.mjs` passes; `check-bundle-faults.mjs` broke each of 57 bundles in 8 ways (456 injections) in a throw-away copy of the sandbox profile. The guarantee of AGENTS.md rule 2 held: DSH started every time (the hanging top-level `await` leaves the banner unprinted, as the script documents, and the server still answers), no other bundle lost a boot line, no other bundle lost a route. The first run printed 74 reds, all « the failure is not visible in the log »: 66 of them were bundles the lab's profile does not load (it is a copy of the owner's profile, which switches 9 bundles off and does not declare kybernos-gate, kybernos-no-process and kybernos-relance), so there is nothing to name; the script now skips that assertion for a bundle its profile does not load (ledger T-033). The 8 left are real but minor: a broken package.json of the 4 maison sub-agent providers leaves no line in the log (T-034, P3).
